mechanism_narrative: Higher monthly housing starts (HOUST) indicate robust consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings prospects improve.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in less than 40% of months with HOUST above its 3-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 310.0, it signals accelerating inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in 60% or more of months where CPIAUCSL > 310.0.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises more than 0.1 percentage points and employment (PAYEMS) falls more than 10,000 persons in the prior month, it indicates a rapidly weakening labor market, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE increases >0.1pp and PAYEMS decreases >10,000 persons in the prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in 60% or more of months meeting the UNRATE and PAYEMS condition.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (defined as FEDFUNDS rising for three consecutive months), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to higher discount rates and reduced liquidity.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in 60% or more of months during a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising for 3 consecutive months).

mechanism_narrative: Higher industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust supply-side economic activity, which supports corporate profitability and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window for INDPRO vs SPX 60d returns.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) fall below 700,000, it signals weakening consumer demand, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market sentiment deteriorates.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in 60% or more of months where RSAFS < 700,000.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicates stagflationary pressures, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate margins face squeeze.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS falls >1% and CPIAUCSL rises >0.5% in the prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in 60% or more of months meeting the RSAFS and CPIAUCSL condition.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle labor market tightness regime (UNRATE < 3.5% and rising), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to heightened risk of aggressive monetary policy in response to wage pressures.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in 60% or more of months when UNRATE < 3.5% and rising.
